pages.text:
All Jabu wants to do
is play.

What can he do?
pages.action: Jabu stands thinking, finger on chin
pages.change: Jabu wants to play and wonders how

notes: Jabu alone on an empty dry field, thinking
a small blue frog sits at the far edge of the spread
illustration.only_in_image: A small blue frog watches Jabu from the grass; the text never mentions it.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Diketo!

But who can play
with him?
pages.action: Jabu flings stones into the air
pages.change: He names the game he wants, then asks who could play it with him
pages.question_created: Who will play diketo with Jabu?

notes: Jabu throws stones skyward with arms wide, laughing
the frog leaps among the stones with the same open-armed pose
illustration.only_in_image: The picture shows what diketo is (stones tossed up and caught) and the frog copying Jabu's joyful pose.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
“Mama,
come and
play with
me.”

But Mama is cooking
pap and spinach.
pages.action: Jabu asks Mama through the window
pages.change: First ask: Mama is cooking and cannot play

notes: Jabu on tiptoe at the window; Mama at the pot looks back at him with a sorry face
the frog hugs a stone at the corner
illustration.only_in_image: Mama looks back at Jabu with a regretful face, and the frog clutches a diketo stone as if waiting.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
“Baba, come
and play with
me.”

But Baba is
busy digging a
big hole.
pages.action: Jabu asks Baba; Baba keeps digging
pages.change: Second ask refused: Baba is busy digging a big hole

notes: Jabu stands hands on hips while soil flies from Baba's spade
the frog shelters under a leaf from the falling soil
illustration.only_in_image: Jabu stands with hands on hips (impatience) and the frog hides under a leaf from the flying soil.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
“Zwe,
come and
play with
me.”

But his brother is busy reading.
pages.action: Jabu peeks round a door at his reading brother
pages.change: Third ask refused: his brother Zwe is reading
pages.question_created: Now that everyone has said no, what will Jabu do?

notes: Jabu peers round the door frame; Zwe glances sideways over a big yellow book
the frog clings to the door frame below Jabu
illustration.only_in_image: Zwe glances at Jabu over the top of his book with a raised eyebrow; the frog clings to the doorframe, peeking like Jabu.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Jabu sits outside.

He wants to play diketo!

But there is no one to play with.
pages.action: Jabu sits on the ground, chin in hand
pages.change: Low point: Jabu sits outside with no one to play with

notes: Jabu sits slumped with a sad face on an empty field
the frog sits opposite him with tears in its eyes
illustration.only_in_image: The frog sits with tears in its eyes, mirroring Jabu's sadness.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
So he plays alone.
It’s not so bad!

He digs a small hole
in the earth.
Then he puts ten small
stones inside the hole.
pages.location: dry yard, close up on the ground
pages.action: Jabu digs a small hole and puts ten stones in
pages.change: Jabu decides to play alone and finds it is not so bad

notes: close-up of Jabu's hand over a scooped hollow with stones
the frog leaps toward the stones
illustration.only_in_image: The frog jumps after the stones as if joining the game.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
So much fun!

Dad sees Jabu
and stops digging
his big hole.
pages.action: Jabu tumbles laughing; Dad stops digging and looks over
pages.change: Jabu's fun is so loud that Dad stops his work and notices

notes: Jabu rolls backward with legs in the air, laughing; stones scattered round his small hole
Dad shades his eyes beside a now very large hole; the frog sits smiling on a stone
illustration.only_in_image: Jabu has tumbled over backwards laughing, and Dad's hole has grown much bigger than Jabu's small one.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Mama comes out with some
pap and spinach.
pages.action: Mama brings plates; Dad kneels at Jabu's hole
pages.change: Mama comes out with the food she was cooking

notes: Dad kneels at Jabu's hole holding stones; Jabu explains the game
Mama approaches carrying two plates; the frog throws stones in the air
illustration.only_in_image: Dad is already kneeling at Jabu's hole with stones in his hand, playing diketo with him; the text never says he joined.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
Zwe looks out
the window
and sees
everyone.

He doesn’t want to miss
out on all the fun.
So he goes to join them.
pages.location: inside at the window, looking out
pages.action: Zwe looks out the window and goes to join
pages.change: Zwe sees the fun outside and goes to join them
pages.question_created: What happens when everyone is together?

notes: over-the-shoulder view from Zwe at the window onto the family in the yard
the frog peeks over the window sill
illustration.only_in_image: The frog peeks over the window sill, as if calling Zwe out too.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.change: Wordless: the whole family laughs together, Dad's hand on Jabu's shoulder

notes: tight close-up of four laughing faces against warm yellow and blue
the yellow-blue background echoes the diketo spread
illustration.only_in_image: The whole family laughs together, Dad's hand on Jabu's shoulder; the spread carries the payoff without words.

pages.label: OBSERVED

pages.text:
At last, Jabu has people
to play with.
pages.location: close-up on the ground at the hole
pages.action: Many hands reach for the stones
pages.change: Jabu at last has people to play with
pages.page_turn_note: last story spread; the back page is a frog vignette (skipped)

notes: top-down view of four pairs of hands around the hole, picking up stones
the frog joins at the edge
illustration.only_in_image: Four people's hands (one wearing a bead bracelet) play around the hole, and the frog plays too: the family is shown inside the game, not named.
